affected_system: housing-stability, eviction prevention, shelter diversion, and support coordination
alternatives: compare eligible treated and credible untreated units for phased rental assistance and legal-support program
estimate pre-specified overall and distributional effects of phased rental assistance and legal-support program
pair randomized lottery or quasi-random eligibility evaluation with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Court, assistance, shelter, outreach, housing, and service records use privacy-preserving linkage.
Risk models support outreach only and never determine legal rights or automatic denial.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain pre-intervention conditions for phased rental assistance and legal-support program.

constraints.description: The homelessness prevention and housing stability evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: homelessness response director and housing-stability administrator
decision_question: Did phased prevention support improve verified housing stability without exclusion or delayed harm?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The homelessness prevention and housing stability evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
independence_key.decision_object: phased rental assistance and legal-support program
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for phased rental assistance and legal-support program passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: randomized lottery or quasi-random eligibility evaluation
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in verified stable housing retention

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased rental assistance and legal-support program, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in verified stable housing retention
distributional gap in change in verified stable housing retention
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer long-term stability, well-being, or causal impact from payment issuance alone.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for phased rental assistance and legal-support program passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.

title: Evaluate rental assistance and legal support
transportability_risks: Eviction law, rents, benefits, shelter systems, informal displacement, and data linkage differ.
Administrative records omit people who do not seek or cannot access services.
